stem.text: A voltmeter gives readings that are larger than the true values and has a systematic error that varies with voltage.
Which graph shows the calibration curve for the voltmeter?

A.alt: Graph of true value/V against meter reading/V, both axes from 0 to 4.

C.alt: Graph of true value/V against meter reading/V, both axes from 0 to 4.
